whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Afra Tafri Cafe & Restaurant,

I noticed your cafe has an incredible 4.3★ rating with over 6,000 reviews in Kidwaipuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page for new diners.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu, aur location guide integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/afratafri

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine Afra Tafri Cafe & Restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu showcase, and your strong 6,000+ Google review highlights on West Boring Canal Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur reservation setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
